# Lookup Table 4 – Time Per Stroke for Manual Process

## Purpose
This lookup table defines the **time per stroke (seconds)** for manual press operations based on:
- Sheet Thickness
- Machine Tonnage
- Part Complexity (Simple, Intermediate, Complex)

**Unit:** Seconds (sec)

## Tonnages
`10, 20, 30, 50, 80, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400, 500, 800, 1000, 1500, 2000`
